lines.text: The root is Port! Portable, important.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus carry?

words.ex: The sales team uses portable projectors for client visits.
It is important to drink enough water.

publish.title: Port root: portable and important
publish.value: Port comes from Latin "portare" (to carry). Words: portable and important. important = im + port.
